name: print-social-coffee-friends-posts-with-cute-cup-and-donut-characters
title: 'Coffee Friends' pack with smiling cup and donut characters in red, pink and blue
whatItIs: Five flat posts with cute illustrated characters (a smiling cup with a donut hat, a croissant, a pour-over), wheat sprigs and coffee beans in red-orange, pink, cream and cobalt, plus mixed outline and solid headlines ('Welcome to Coffee Friends', 'What's your coffee type?').
whatItMeans: Cheerful and charming; friendly characters make a café feel like a place to hang out.
techniques: Mix outline and solid versions of one typeface.
Use a limited flat palette across posts.
Ask a question post to invite comments.

vocabulary.definition: A cute style with simple faces on objects.
Drawings with solid colours and no shading.
